help.summary: If a machine won't wake up
help.intro: On the PC you want to wake, check the following.
help.1: Enable Wake on LAN in the BIOS/UEFI (e.g. “Power on by PCIe”).
help.2: In Device Manager → Network adapters → Power Management, enable “Only allow a magic packet to wake the computer”.
help.3: Turn off “Fast startup” in the power options (it can stop a machine from waking after a shutdown).
help.4: The PC is connected by wired LAN. Wi-Fi almost never works.
help.5: The registered MAC address belongs to the wired NIC.
help.check: Whether a machine is up is checked by connecting to a TCP port you choose for each machine, because Windows does not answer ping. Use 3389 for Remote Desktop or 445 for file sharing.
